recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. No additional current-build source location needs a FHIR-25282 change; remaining old wording matches are historical artifacts outside the active build scope.
issue_request: FHIR-25282 was Published/Persuasive for R5 as a FHIR-core technical correction. It asked to change the eld-1 human description from saying there must be a definition to saying there must be a description, because the expression already referred to ElementDefinition.slicing.description.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-25282 source commit was found. The relevant invariant was later moved by FHIR-31400 from ElementDefinition to StructureDefinition.snapshot.element in commit e1d0f92b131400c670177b59edf833030631a570, carrying forward the misleading definition wording into the current sdf-28 source location.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes for 2020-04-20 record FHIR-25282 as an agreed technical correction with no vote needed. FHIR-31400 explains why the current authoritative location is StructureDefinition.snapshot.element rather than the original ElementDefinition invariant; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch and was not independently decided here. source/fhir.ini lists StructureDefinition as an active current resource and conformance artifact, so the edited XML is in build scope.
reconciliation: Changed source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml so sdf-28 now says 'If there are no discriminators, there must be a description'. The invariant expression was left unchanged because it already checks slicing.discriminator.exists() or slicing.description.exists().
source_changes: source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml: changed the sdf-28 human value from 'definition' to 'description'.
